messages:
olivia: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5432? CI is failing on a flaky test, blocking the dedupe rollout.

ci-bot: build #12987 — job `linux-gpu-e2e` failed (exit code 1). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/12987/logs

mike: looking now. which test is spiking? thanks for the ping.

olivia: it’s e2e/serve_cache_test.py::test_kv_cache_eviction — intermittent timeout on 'eviction with many keys'. repro in logs shows assertion timeout at 30s. snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: cache did not evict expected key within 30s
```

anya: can you paste the exact command you used to repro locally? I can try a run on my workstation.

olivia: yeah: `pytest tests/e2e/serve_cache_test.py::test_kv_cache_eviction -k eviction -q -x` — locally it fails ~1/10 runs under 4090 docker image.

mike: got it. I suspect a race with async flush+kv-compact. quick patch idea: increase wait to 60s or add a small backoff retry. will try reproducing and push a tiny fix to the branch.

olivia: if you push a test-only tweak, please mark it with a TODO and reference GH-5432 so we can follow up with a proper fix. deploy team is waiting on green.

dev-bot: @mike — rerun requested by olivia. /ci rerun 12987

ci-bot: rerun triggered for build #12987 (rebuild 12987.1). status: queued.

anya: if you can’t get a robust fix quick, consider marking the test flaky in CI config (flaky-tests.txt) so the rollout isn’t blocked.

mike: quick update — repro confirmed locally, pushing a small retry loop now. will watch the rerun.

ci-bot: build #12987.1 succeeded ✅ — all jobs passed.

olivia: awesome, thanks both. mike — when you merge, please squash and include a note to follow up on the race in a proper PR. I’ll proceed with the dedupe rollout after merge.

mike: will do. merging in ~10m once I rebase. :thumbsup:
